audience: sales and support teams that check lead phone numbers before they call or text them

useCases.title: Confirm a lead's phone number is valid
useCases.text: Validate a phone number and read whether it is valid, its country, carrier, line type and prepaid flag. Use the result to confirm the lead gave a real number.

useCases.title: Review a lead list by activity score
useCases.text: Validate each number in a lead list one by one. Keep the numbers with an activity score of 30 or below for review before you call.

useCases.title: Screen US numbers for TCPA litigator risk
useCases.text: Check a US number for TCPA litigator risk before you call or text it. The check works only when the add-on is enabled on your Trestle key.

useCases.title: Route inbound calls by line type
useCases.text: Read the line type of a caller's number, such as mobile, landline or VOIP. Use the line type to decide how the call is routed.
